svg.title: Halgrave — the site plan, to scale
svg.text: Halgrave, in plan, to scale
the whole region map.json declares — 70 × 44 × 150 blocks — with the party the delve is built for standing on it
Solid blue is the box the site plan hands each part. The dashed outline is what that part declares in zones.json, laid in that box at true scale, put
the way round that fits best — cut off at the edge of the sheet where it runs past. Which way a part actually turns is a property of the rule that
opens on the box, so no sheet here asserts one. A grammar program is region-polymorphic, so a part whose declared size disagrees with its box may
still BUILD there: it builds a different piece from the one that was reviewed, which is what the plan’s own DW0806 debt is about.

a party of four
4 blocks abreast
Z7 Bell Tower 钟塔
the plan gives it 36 × 31 × 9 · 25 min of the run
it declares 41 × 48 × 125 — it refuses here
best case either way round: NO 48 in 31 high · NO 41 in 9 one way · NO 125 in 36 the other
the player climbs sixteen metres of tower with a broken flight in it
floor: the ramp and tower foot, +14; the belfry floor, +30
Z5 Hall & Keep 大厅与主楼
the plan gives it 36 × 31 × 9 · 25 min of the run
it declares 11 × 11 × 76 — it refuses here
best case either way round: OK 11 in 31 high · NO 11 in 9 one way · NO 76 in 36 the other
the player fights a boss in a clear hall, then talks to a dead man
floor: the keep floor, +12
Z6 Cistern Deep 深蓄水池
the plan gives it 36 × 13 × 35 · 25 min of the run
it declares 40 × 10 × 100 — it refuses here
best case either way round: OK 10 in 13 high · NO 40 in 35 one way · NO 100 in 36 the other
the player crosses the delve’s largest interior by the bay it is standing in
floor: the cistern floor, −0.15; the well bed, −2.3
Z4 Chapel Ward 礼拜堂中庭
the plan gives it 36 × 31 × 17 · 25 min of the run
it declares 27 × 12 × 33 — it refuses here
best case either way round: OK 12 in 31 high · NO 27 in 17 one way · OK 33 in 36 the other
the player fights a pair in the open — the first fight with room to lose properly
floor: the cloister paving, +9
Z1 Cliff Road 崖道
the plan gives it 17 × 18 × 70 · 15 min of the run
it declares 16 × 24 × 72 — it builds here, at the box’s size
best case either way round: NO 24 in 18 high · OK 16 in 17 one way · NO 72 in 70 the other
the player walks single file with no room to circle anything it meets
floor: the cut ledge, +4.0 (+2.0 at the K2 gap)
Z3 Drowned Ward 下沉外庭
the plan gives it 17 × 13 × 70 · 25 min of the run
it declares 40 × 10 × 60 — it refuses here
best case either way round: OK 10 in 13 high · NO 40 in 17 one way · OK 60 in 70 the other
the player chooses when to leave a raised path for water it has been taught to fear
floor: the ward floor, −1.5; the causeway top, +0.4
Z2 Gatehouse 门楼
the plan gives it 36 × 13 × 35 · 20 min of the run
it declares 25 × 18 × 56 — it refuses here
best case either way round: NO 18 in 13 high · OK 25 in 35 one way · NO 56 in 36 the other
the player opens a shut gate outward, from the inside
floor: the gate passage, +2.5
Z0 Barrow Shore 冢泽潮滩
the plan gives it 40 × 8 × 80 · 10 min of the run
it declares 40 × 18 × 80 — it refuses here
best case either way round: NO 18 in 8 high · OK 40 in 40 one way · OK 80 in 80 the other
the player walks north across open sand until the sand ends at cliff
floor: the tidal sand, −1.2
N
50 blocks · 1 block = 1 m
the box the site plan hands the part
what the part declares, where it builds
what the part declares, where it refuses
a player — one block in plan
the order of arrival (a sequence, not a path)
sea
What is in each box
transcribed from beats.md, “What fills it” — nothing here is invented for the drawing
Z0 Barrow Shore
· the cairn field, one heap per body recovered
· the tide-stake line, the flat’s lethal boundary
· the tutorial kill
· Emeric’s shelf, the last dry ground
· at the Dead Ebb, the ground below the stake line and the
several hundred standing on it
Z1 Cliff Road
· the ledge itself as a one-body corridor
· the bracket line, the zone’s only map
· the K2 gap — a fallen shelf round a blind bend
· the shover
· the rope store the road passes through
Z2 Gatehouse
· the passage and its ambush
· the murder-hole floor above it, a real reachable storey
· the portcullis chamber and its winch
· the porter’s guardroom
· the roof, and the Gatewright fought on it
· the drain channel down the passage
Z3 Drowned Ward
· the causeway spine and its two weed pinches
· two arcades climbable end to end as an upper route
· the water-gate tower’s storeys
· the sunk boats and the ferry-tally in one of them
· at the Dead Ebb, the entire floor as new ground
Z4 Chapel Ward
· four arcade walks
· the three stations of Ide’s round
· the collapsed canopy as broken cover
· the rubble the corpse-ambush hides in
· the banded door
· the hour-vault beneath
Z5 Hall & Keep
· the hearth as arena cover
· the tapestry sequence, read panel by panel along the
wall
· the roof-post grid Ridd is fought around
· the far arch and its chairs
· Ancel’s chamber
· the keep stair
Z6 Cistern Deep
· ranked piers that make the plan legible from any bay
· the collapse shaft’s rubble cone as climbable terrain
· the supply channel as a lethal line across a uniform
floor
· the Choir’s echo vault
· the well head and its apron
· the silt bed the sea uncovers
Z7 Bell Tower
· the ramp approach between the collapsed low buildings
· the tower foot
· the broken first flight and the rope that bridges it
· the ringing floor
· the louvre stage
· a belfry walked AROUND a bell that is itself a building
